ValidationRule.description: Check if the user has the permission to create Sales Order.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( Source_Entity__c , 'Modon - Egypt' ), NOT( $Permission.Egypt_Sales_Order_Create_Permission ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to Create Sales Order, because you don't have required permissions. Contact System Administrator to assign the permission set 'Egypt Sales Order Permissions'.
